frozen_generator.event_lifecycle: same original pullback survives signal and rearms to PULLBACK_ACTIVE with fresh exhaustion required; original event start and max-age remain frozen

source_grounded_event_deaths: PARENT_OPPOSITION: current structural parent becomes opposite the pullback side
STRUCTURAL_INVALIDATION: tick crosses the frozen parent invalidation boundary plus S06 invalidation_buffer_atr
MAX_PULLBACK_AGE: original pullback age exceeds frozen 513.6575 seconds

profiles.validity: pending token survives until next observed flat tick regardless of later event death; 13D admit-all control
pending token dies if original pullback reaches causal PARENT_OPPOSITION before flat observation; structural/age death ignored diagnostically
pending token dies on causal PARENT_OPPOSITION or STRUCTURAL_INVALIDATION before flat observation; max-age death ignored diagnostically
pending token dies on any causal original-pullback death event: parent opposition, structural invalidation, or max-age expiry

causal_end_time_rule: Episode end timestamps may be precomputed for replay storage, but an admission decision may consult only whether current tick time has reached/passed that already-causal end timestamp. No future end reason/time can affect any earlier tick.
selection_rule: The canonical candidate is PENDING_FULL_EVENT_VALID because it follows the frozen DH03 event lifetime. Looser nested profiles exist only to attribute which event-death class causes pending rejection. Carry forward only if generator/13D controls reproduce exactly and the validity rule materially improves trade/win/economic parity without any new numeric threshold.
